ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Adani Enterprises Limited announced a minor logistical revision, shifting its scheduled interaction with investors/analysts at the Jefferies 5th India Forum from September 16th to September 17th, 2026. The company confirmed the meeting will be physical in Gurgaon and noted the presentation is available on its website. This is a routine administrative update with no material financial impact or discernible red flags.
